sources.note: ONC mandatory disclosures page. NextGen Office described as fully integrated small practice solution (<10 providers). Lists EHR, PM, billing, patient portal (NextGen PxP Portal v23), Surescripts e-prescribing, lab/immunization interfaces. Portal and lab/immunization interfaces have separate licensing fees. MFA required for login.

Main vendor homepage. NextGen Healthcare offers EHR, PM, RCM, patient experience, analytics, and interoperability products. ~2,900 employees. Serves 124,000+ providers. Two main products: NextGen Enterprise (large practices) and NextGen Office (small practices). AI ambient assist, 26+ specialty templates.

NextGen Office product page. Cloud-based EHR/PM for <10 providers. Details on AI Ambient Assist, e-prescribing, lab connections, patient portal with online scheduling/telehealth/payments/refills, integrated billing with clearinghouse/EDI, eligibility verification, MACRA/MIPS reporting, 40+ specialty markets.

Company history timeline. Founded 1974 as QSI. Key acquisitions: Clinitec (1996, EMR), Micromed (1997, PM), HealthFusion/MediTouch (2016, cloud EHR), Mirth (2013, interoperability), Topaz (2019, behavioral health), Medfusion (2019, patient experience), OTTO Health (2019, telehealth). Taken private by Thoma Bravo in 2023.

AVS Medical reseller page for NextGen Office. Detailed workflow descriptions: access/discovery, intake/pre-visit, visit management, care coordination, health management. Mentions RCM services, MIPS consulting, care management support, remote patient monitoring, electronic statements with bill pay.

Software Finder review. 124,000+ providers served. AI Ambient Assist with 90%+ accuracy, notes in 30 seconds. Claims through Office Ally clearinghouse. Charge Review Rules Engine. Specialties include urology, dental, dermatology, family practice, gastro, surgery, geriatrics, cardiology, pain management, behavioral health, urgent care. 75% positive on customization, 75% negative on performance/support.

NextGen Office primary care page. Cloud-based EHR with billing, AI documentation, chronic care management support, room status dashboard, digital intake forms, virtual visits, e-prescribing, RPM, electronic statements.

Confirmed MediTouch rebranding to NextGen Office after HealthFusion acquisition. MediTouch started 1998 by two family medicine physicians. Modules included EHR, billing, PM, collections, patient portal, and clearinghouse.
HCI Innovation Group article on QSI acquiring HealthFusion for $165M in 2016 to gain cloud-based EHR/PM platform for small practices.
MetroPM reseller page confirming NextGen Office was formerly MediTouch EHR, designed for iPad/tablet use, web-based touchscreen EHR for small practices.
